title: [review] project-LICHEN-5pe7: misleading nvm_failed comment
description: The comment at line 1614 of `lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/oscore.c` says "After common wipe in common_wipe" but nvm_failed does NOT go through common_wipe first — it executes its mutex/rollback logic while stack variables are still live, then `goto common_wipe` for wiping. The comment should say "Before common wipe" or be reworded for clarity. Functionally correct (no security issue), just a documentation inaccuracy.
